20261119-physics-g11.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261119-physics-g11.material: E tinyere ihe A dị 3 kg na ihe B dị 2 kg ka ha na-emetụ onwe ha n'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A. Kedu ọsọ nke ihe abụọ na ịdị ukwuu nke ike A na-akwọ B, n'usoro?
20261119-physics-g11.thinking.0: a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A

20261119-physics-g11.s.s1.hint.1: Ike niile na B = ike A na-etinye na B = m_B × a

20261122-physics-g11-1.title: Electromagnetic induction miri emi
20261122-physics-g11-1.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Electromagnetic induction miri emi iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261122-physics-g11-1.material: [Electromagnetic induction miri emi] Mgbe e wetara magnet nso coil, induced emf na-apụta (iwu Faraday na iwu Lenz). Ọkụ eletrik e kpatara na-asọ n'ụzọ nke 'na-egbochi' mgbanwe magnetic flux site na coil. Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara physics nke a, iji mezuo nchekwa gịnị?
20261122-physics-g11-1.s.s1.prompt: [Electromagnetic induction miri emi] Mgbe e wetara magnet nso coil, induced emf na-apụta (iwu Faraday na iwu Lenz). Ọkụ eletrik e kpatara na-asọ n'ụzọ nke 'na-egbochi' mgbanwe magnetic flux site na coil. Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara physics nke a, iji mezuo nchekwa gịnị?
20261122-physics-g11-1.s.s1.explain: N'iwu Lenz, na induced emf na-etolite n'ụzọ na-egbochi mgbanwe flux bụ nsonaazụ dị mkpa nke iwu nchekwa ume. Ọ bụrụ na ọ nyere mgbanwe aka, a ga-enwe igwe mmegharị na-enweghị njedebe, ebe ume na-abawanye onwe ya na-enweghị ọrụ nke ike mpụga.
20261122-physics-g11-1.s.s1.hint.0: Ọ bụrụ na ọkụ eletrik na-asọ n'ụzọ na-adọta magnet karịa mgbe ọ na-abịa nso, a ga-enwe ọdịiche: ume ga-aga n'ihu na-apụta ma ọ bụrụ na a hapụ ya.
20261122-physics-g11-1.s.s1.hint.1: Ọ bụ ụkpụrụ bụ isi nke okike, iwu nchekwa ume.

20261122-physics-g11-2.title: N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ dị elu
20261122-physics-g11-2.topic: N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ dị elu
20261122-physics-g11-2.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ dị elu iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261122-physics-g11-2.material: N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ dị elu, ìhè na-agbasa n'ime isi fiber ruo ebe dị anya na-enweghị mfu n'ihi 'nlaghachi ndị zuru ezu n'ime (total internal reflection)'. Kedu ọnọdụ ziri ezi maka nlaghachi ndị zuru ezu n'ime ime?
20261122-physics-g11-2.thinking.0: N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ dị elu
20261122-physics-g11-2.s.s1.prompt: N'ozi fiber-optic internet ọsọ dị elu, ìhè na-agbasa n'ime isi fiber ruo ebe dị anya na-enweghị mfu n'ihi 'nlaghachi ndị zuru ezu n'ime (total internal reflection)'. Kedu ọnọdụ ziri ezi maka nlaghachi ndị zuru ezu n'ime ime?
20261122-physics-g11-2.s.s1.explain: Nlaghachi zuru ezu n'ime bụ ihe omume nke, mgbe ìhè na-esi na ngwakọta nwere refractive index dị elu gaa na nke dị ala, ma akụkụ ntinye karịrị akụkụ dị mkpa, enweghị ebili mmiri refracted na-etolite n'ókè ma a na-eweghachi ìhè $100\%$.
20261122-physics-g11-2.s.s1.hint.0: Ìhè na-agbagọ mgbe ọ si na isi (refractive index dị elu) gaa na cladding dị ntakịrị.
20261122-physics-g11-2.s.s1.hint.1: Ma e gafere akụkụ dị mkpa, ọ naghị agbagọ a na-eweghachikwa ya 100%.
20261122-physics-g11-2.s.s1.o.o0: Ìhè na-abata site na ngwakọta nwere refractive index dị elu (ngwakọta oke) gaa na nke nwere refractive index dị ala (ngwakọta ọkụ), a na-edokwa akụkụ ntinye karịa akụkụ dị mkpa (critical angle)

20261122-physics-g11-2.s.s1.o.o2: Akụkụ ntinye nke ìhè bụ 0° mgbe niile
20261122-physics-g11-2.s.s1.o.o3: A na-awụpụ ime fiber ka ọ bụrụ vacuum

20261119-physics-g12.material: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere ibu m na ụgwọ q na-abata n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya B n'ọsọ v ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi nke ọma radius r na period T nke ụzọ gburugburu ya?
